requiredProbeProtocol.barrier: file-v1: atomically write /fault-control/barriers/<scenario-id>.json with schemaVersion=1, scenario, stage, phase=blocked, roomID, operationID, activationEpoch and hostBootID after the real host stage is reached.
requiredProbeProtocol.resume: Wait for /fault-control/releases/<scenario-id>.json with matching operationID; the coordinator writes it only after Docker confirms the network fault.

scenarios.assert: one effective writer while both hosts retain database access
uncommitted command is not acknowledged; healthy owner remains usable
healthy owner result is retained and failed item reports unavailable
authorization failure does not become success or empty result
same durable operation result and one business effect after retry
